title: TOA Media Library Catalogue Schema
description: JSON Schema defining the structure, validation rules and constraints for asset records in the TOA media library catalogue. Implements FR-006, FR-008 (non-invention), FR-015 (metadata completeness).

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: A single recoverable media item (image, vector, design file, branded material). See data-model.md § Asset for full specification.

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique stable identifier, independent of storage provider. Must be globally unique within catalogue.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Source tracking. Must be explicit; never fabricated. Mark unknown or unverifiable as 'unknown' per FR-008.
examples: Figma file 'TOA Brand Guide', page 'Logos', exported 2026-10-17 via Figma Make
archive scan of original scan files

format.title: Format(s)
format.description: File format(s); primary and secondary (e.g. original SVG + exported PNG). From FR-004, FR-006.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Width × height with unit. Null if unknown. For print, include DPI metadata (FR-004).

dpi.description: Resolution for print assets (300 DPI minimum per Q2 resolution)

colour_space.description: For print assets, specify RGB or CMYK (FR-004, Q2 resolution)

print_suitable.title: Print Suitable
print_suitable.description: Boolean or null (unknown). Assesses print resolution (300 DPI minimum) and format compatibility (FR-004, Q2 resolution).

print_notes.title: Print Notes
print_notes.description: Freeform description of print requirements, constraints, or quality assessment.
examples: Original 300 DPI TIFF, CMYK; suitable for full-colour print
Web PNG only; low resolution; not suitable for print

usages.title: Usages
usages.description: Contexts where asset is or was used (e.g. 'website hero', 'book chapter 3', 'social media')

alt_text.title: Alt Text
alt_text.description: Accessibility description; max 125 chars recommended. Mark 'unknown' or 'unrecoverable' if not found; never fabricated (FR-008).
examples: TOA Media Library brand logo on white background

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Human-readable label; max 255 chars. Mark 'unknown' if unavailable.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Creator, artist, photographer, or source attribution. Mark 'unknown' or 'unrecoverable' if not found; NEVER fabricated (FR-008).
examples: Original artwork by Jane Doe; scanned from archive

rights_notes.title: Rights Notes
rights_notes.description: Licensing, usage restrictions, copyright, or verification status. Mark 'unknown' if unavailable; NEVER fabricated (FR-008).

recovery_status.title: Recovery Status
recovery_status.description: Outcome of recovery attempt. From data-model.md § recovery_status enum (FR-005, FR-015).

recovery_notes.title: Recovery Notes
recovery_notes.description: Reason for partial or failed recovery; impact on catalogue/validation (FR-005).
examples: Figma Make extraction succeeded but dimensions lost; verified manually
Source file not found; cannot recover

recovery_method.title: Recovery Method
recovery_method.description: How asset was obtained (FR-001, FR-005). From data-model.md § recovery_method enum.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when asset was catalogued (not asset creation date).

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last modification (metadata verification, correction, etc.)

assetRelationship.title: Asset Relationship
assetRelationship.description: Relationship between assets (original ↔ derivative, asset ↔ usage). See data-model.md § AssetRelationship.

source_asset_id.title: Source Asset ID
source_asset_id.description: Asset that is the origin or parent (must exist in Asset records).

target_asset_id.title: Target Asset ID
target_asset_id.description: Asset that derives from or uses the source (must exist in Asset records; cannot equal source).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Additional context (e.g., 'scaled 50% for web', 'colour mode changed RGB→CMYK')

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Whether relationship has been validated or is inferred.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when relationship was recorded.

catalogueVersion.title: Catalogue Version
catalogueVersion.description: Version of this schema and catalogue

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: Array of asset relationships (original ↔ derivative, asset ↔ usage)
